query:
SELECT hs.id, hs.rfqId, hs.chain, hs.status, hs.htlcAddress, hs.locktime, hs.claimTxId, hs.claimedAt, hs.settledVia, hs.createdAt
FROM htlc_swaps hs
ORDER BY hs.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
